adoption.default: exact baseline query expressions and hybrid gating; no new fallback
adoption.measurements: Frozen experimental path before adding the opt-in guard; not evidence of default-on acceptance. No holdout-driven retuning followed rejection.

post_review_verification.compared: Every returned file path in rank order, not only first-hit ranks

freeze.superseded_reason: Inspection before reading holdout results found lowercase dotted terms incorrectly removed by the legacy fallback. Added direct SQLite regression and corrected the fallback. Original result kept unread.

development.scope: production search, shared CUDA embedding per query, shared reranker, SQLite backups
development.metric: First acceptable file's chunk rank, alternatives count as one target; discounted hit is 1/log2(rank+1), zero past rank10. Not multi-relevance NDCG.
